title: European Central Bank: Hawkish path toward December peak – Deutsche Bank
summary: Deutsche Bank’s Mark Wall and colleagues say the European Central Bank delivered a 25bp hike to 2.50% in September, with President Lagarde describing it as a no‑brainer.

title: US Dollar: CPI volatility risk and limited upside – BBH
summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad notes the US Dollar (USD) is supported by recent risk aversion and a modestly hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) repricing after US August Producer Price Index (PPI), but stresses that August Consumer Price Index (CPI) will be decisive for next week’s Fed meet
